featured_reviews.name: Stringzzz
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Metro INOX Cinema, and my overall experience was extremely enjoyable and comfortable. This cinema hall perfectly blends a classic feel with modern movie-watching amenities, making it a great choice for both regular viewers and cinema lovers who appreciate a well-maintained theatre.

The screen and sound quality were excellent. The visuals were sharp, bright, and immersive, which made the movie even more engaging. The sound system was well balanced—loud enough to create impact without being overwhelming. Dialogues were clear, and background music and effects were crisp, enhancing the overall cinematic experience.

The seating arrangement deserves special mention. The seats were comfortable, well-spaced, and offered a clear view of the screen from almost every angle. Legroom was sufficient, allowing for a relaxed experience even during a long movie. The auditorium was clean and well maintained, which added to the comfort level.

The ambience of Metro INOX has a pleasant and premium feel. The lobby area was neat, organized, and not overly crowded. The lighting and interiors give a classy vibe, making the wait time before the show quite comfortable. Entry and exit were well managed, avoiding unnecessary rush or confusion.

Food and beverages were also satisfactory. The snacks counter offered the usual cinema favourites like popcorn, cold drinks, and nachos. While prices are on the higher side—as expected in multiplexes—the quality and freshness were good. The staff at the counter were polite and quick in handling orders, even during peak hours.

Another positive aspect was the staff behavior and overall management. The staff members were helpful, courteous, and ensured smooth operations throughout the show. Ticket checking, seating guidance, and cleanliness were handled efficiently. Restrooms were clean and well maintained, which is an important factor for any public place.

Overall, Metro INOX Cinema provides a reliable, comfortable, and enjoyable movie-watching experience. Whether you’re going for a weekend show with friends, a family outing, or a solo movie break, this place delivers on quality, comfort, and ambience. I would definitely recommend Metro INOX Cinema to anyone looking for a pleasant and hassle-free cinema experience.

featured_reviews.name: DHANESH PATIDAR
featured_reviews.review_text: Metro INOX at Marine Lines is a standout cinema that beautifully blends Art Deco heritage with modern luxury, offering a visual treat before the movie even starts. The viewing experience is top-tier, featuring crisp Laser projection and immersive Dolby Atmos sound, while the Insignia screens provide unmatched comfort with recliner seating and butler service. However, this premium experience comes with South Mumbai pricing for tickets and food, and the biggest drawback is the severe lack of parking, often forcing patrons to use distant pay-and-park slots. Overall, it is a perfect spot for a lavish movie date or a special night out if you arrive by cab, but a logistical headache if you plan to drive.

featured_reviews.name: Naihrit Halder
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Eros IMAX, Mumbai, and it ended up being one of my favourite movie experiences in the city. There’s something special about this place—the moment you see the iconic art‑deco building from outside, it already feels different from the typical multiplex vibe.
Inside, the theatre is spacious, clean, and surprisingly comfortable. The IMAX screen here genuinely enhances the movie experience without overwhelming you, and the sound quality is crystal clear. I watched a film here recently, and the visuals + audio made it feel so immersive.
One thing I really appreciate about Eros is how well-organized everything is—from the ticket counters to entering the auditorium. The staff was polite and helpful, and the crowd felt more relaxed compared to the usual rush you see in other cinemas.
Snacks are priced reasonably for a theatre in South Mumbai, and the washrooms and waiting areas are clean and well-maintained.
Plus, walking out after the show into the Churchgate/Marine Drive area just completes the whole experience. It’s one of the few cinemas where both the movie and the location feel equally enjoyable.
Definitely a great spot for movie lovers. I’d happily visit again!

featured_reviews.name: ARYAN PATIL
featured_reviews.review_text: Watched a movie at Eros INOX and had a great experience overall. The screen quality is excellent with sharp visuals, and the sound system is immersive, making the movie truly engaging. Seating is comfortable with good legroom, so even long movies feel relaxed. The theatre is clean, well maintained, and the staff is organized, which makes entry and exit smooth. Definitely one of the better places in the city to enjoy a movie.

featured_reviews.name: Arjun Pitroda
featured_reviews.review_text: Had an incredible experience at Eros INOX! I’ve watched two IMAX movies here recently and both were spectacular. The restoration is stunning—they’ve kept the classic Art Deco charm and those iconic marble stairs, but the theater itself is world-class. The IMAX with Laser technology is super sharp, and the sound is immersive without being overwhelming. It’s easily one of the best places in Mumbai to catch a blockbuster. Highly recommend for the nostalgia and the tech!

featured_reviews.name: Yash Popat
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Stunning Revival of a Mumbai Icon!

I recently visited the newly revamped Eros Theatre at Churchgate, now under the PVR banner and featuring a grand IMAX screen. I must say, the experience was nothing short of spectacular.

The restoration has beautifully retained the Art Deco charm of this iconic building, blending heritage with modern technology seamlessly. From the moment you enter, the space exudes elegance and nostalgia, yet feels fresh and world-class.

The IMAX screen is massive and immersive, and the sound system is crystal clear, delivering every note and dialogue with incredible depth. Seats are comfortable, the ambience is premium, and the entire setup does justice to both classic cinema lovers and modern moviegoers.

Kudos to PVR for respecting the legacy of Eros while transforming it into a state-of-the-art cinema destination. If you’re in Mumbai and love movies, this place is an absolute must-visit!

featured_reviews.name: Musafir Hun Yaaron
featured_reviews.review_text: Eros Cinema, a landmark in Mumbai’s Churchgate area, first opened its doors in 1938, showcasing exquisite Art Deco architecture designed by Shorabji Bhedwar.  After ceasing operations in 2017, this iconic theater underwent extensive renovations and reopened in February 2024 as Eros INOX IMAX, Mumbai’s first standalone IMAX with Laser theatre.  The transformation seamlessly blends the original architectural charm with state-of-the-art cinematic technology, offering audiences an immersive viewing experience. The revamped cinema now features a 305-seat IMAX auditorium on the second floor, while preserving the historic facade and grand foyer, symbolizing a harmonious fusion of heritage and modernity.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Regal Cinema is one of those classic theatres in Mumbai that carries a lot of nostalgia for many people. I recently watched Kerala Files 2 here, and while the theatre wasn’t very crowded (possibly due to the film itself), the experience reminded me why Regal still has its own charm.

I’ve been coming to Regal since childhood. In its earlier decades, it was considered one of the more prestigious cinemas in the city with a strong reputation. Over time, with the rise of modern multiplexes, that status has naturally changed, but the theatre still retains a certain old-school character that many movie lovers appreciate.

The cinema was clean and well maintained, and the balcony seating still provides a very comfortable and enjoyable movie-watching experience.

Food options are limited compared to multiplexes, but there are still decent snacks available.

Overall, while it may not compete with the luxury of newer multiplex chains, Regal Cinema remains a charming and historic place to watch a film in South Mumbai. For those who enjoy a bit of nostalgia along with their movie, it is definitely still worth visiting.

Established in 1933, it has been a significant part of Mumbai's cultural landscape, showcasing a mix of Bollywood and international films. The cinema features comfortable seating and modern screening technology, providing an enjoyable viewing experience. Its central location in Colaba makes it a popular destination for both locals and tourists. Regal Cinema not only offers a glimpse into the city's cinematic history but also serves as a vibrant hub for film enthusiasts in Mumbai.. inside interior not that great, leg space less too

featured_reviews.review_text:
Regal Cinema has that classic old world vibe you don’t find in modern multiplexes anymore. The moment you step inside, it feels like stepping back in time : vintage decor, high ceilings and a heritage aura that makes the movie experience special.

I watched Tere Ishq Mein here and it felt perfect for this theatre. The sound and projection are solid and the seats though old style actually add to the charm. The whole place has a peaceful and nostalgic feel that makes you enjoy the movie even more.

Located right at Colaba, it’s just a short walk from Gateway of India making it a great spot for a movie + evening outing.

If you love classic theatres and want a break from shiny multiplexes, Regal Cinema is absolutely worth it.

featured_reviews.name: Ameer Shaik
featured_reviews.review_text:
Watched Dhurandhar with my friends at Regal Cinemas, Colaba, and it was an experience worth remembering. From the moment we stepped inside this iconic cinema hall, you could feel its timeless charm — Regal isn’t just a theatre, it’s a piece of Mumbai’s film-going legacy. The interiors have that old-world elegance, and the seating and screen were just perfect for enjoying a movie with energy and comfort.

Dhurandhar itself was an absolute blast on the big screen. The story, performances, and background score hit all the right notes, and the audience reaction around us made it even more enjoyable — laughter, cheers, and applause made it feel like we were part of something bigger together.

Watching this film with friends, surrounded by the classic Regal ambiance, added an emotional layer you don’t get in ordinary multiplexes. The sound was crisp, the visuals vibrant, and the overall vibe made the whole evening unforgettable.

Regal Cinemas at Colaba isn’t just a place to watch a movie — it’s a destination that turns each show into a lasting memory. If you’re in Mumbai and want a cinematic experience with character and soul, this is the place to be. Dhurandhar was great, but watching it here made it unforgettable!

featured_reviews.name: Radhikaa Desai
featured_reviews.review_text:
"Step into old Bombay charm at Regal Cinema !"🎥

Watching a movie at Regal Cinema is like stepping into a slice of Mumbai’s heritage. Built in the 1930s, this iconic art-deco theatre still carries the grandeur of old Bombay. The vintage interiors, high ceilings, and classic design instantly transport you back to the golden era of cinema. 🎥📽

One of the best parts is the ticket pricing–at just around ₹100, it’s far cheaper compared to other multiplexes, making it accessible while still offering a memorable experience. The staff are courteous and helpful, and the upgraded sound and screen quality blend nostalgia with modern convenience.

Located right at the Gateway of India circle, Regal is surrounded by the vibrant energy of Colaba. Parking can be a challenge in this busy area, so arriving early or using public transport is more convenient. The only drawback is the washrooms 🚻, which could be better maintained.

Still, Regal Cinema is more than just a theatre–it’s a cultural landmark. For anyone who loves cinema, architecture, or simply wants to relive the charm of old Mumbai at an affordable price, Regal is a treasure worth visiting.🤌✨️

featured_reviews.name: Suraj Deosarkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited the INOX multiplex at Raghuleela Mega Mall in Kandivali and had a really pleasant experience overall. The location is quite convenient, especially with the mall offering ample parking and access to food courts and shopping options. As for the multiplex itself, it was clean, well-maintained, and the ambiance was quite inviting.

The staff at INOX were courteous and helpful, right from the ticket counter to the ushers inside the theater. The seating was comfortable, with good legroom and clear visibility from every angle. The sound and picture quality were up to the mark, giving a great cinematic experience. I especially liked the recliner section, which was a bit more expensive but definitely worth it for long movies.

The only reason I'm giving 4 stars instead of 5 is because the food prices at the snack counter are on the higher side, which is typical for multiplexes but still feels excessive. Also, during peak hours, the entry and exit process can feel a bit rushed and crowded.

Overall, INOX Raghuleela is a great place to watch movies with friends or family. I’d definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a good movie-going experience in Kandivali.

INOX at Raghuleela Mega Mall in Kandivali West is a popular multiplex cinema located on the second floor of the mall. It offers a convenient and modern movie-watching experience for the residents and visitors of Kandivali and surrounding areas. The multiplex features multiple screens, including 3D-enabled auditoriums with silver screens, providing immersive cinematic experiences. With a total seating capacity of 1275 across its four auditoriums, it can accommodate a significant number of moviegoers.

Beyond just movie screenings, INOX Raghuleela Mega Mall also provides food and beverage options for patrons to enjoy during their visit. The cinema is wheelchair-friendly, ensuring accessibility for all. Located within the bustling Raghuleela Mega Mall, visitors can easily combine a movie outing with shopping, dining, and other entertainment options available in the mall. Its strategic location near Poisar Bus Depot and off S.V. Road makes it easily accessible by various modes of transport.

Today I visited INOX at Raghuleela Mega Mall, Kandivali, and overall it was a pleasant movie-watching experience. The theatre is conveniently located inside the mall and easy to reach by public transport as well as private vehicles. Entry and security checks were smooth, and the overall crowd management felt organized. Booking tickets online made the process quick and hassle-free.
Inside the auditorium, the seating was comfortable and well spaced, allowing for a relaxed viewing experience. The screen quality was sharp, and the sound system was clear and immersive, which enhanced the impact of the movie. The air-conditioning was well balanced and added to the comfort throughout the show. Cleanliness inside the hall and common areas was maintained properly.
The food and beverage counter offered the usual INOX snacks like popcorn, nachos, and soft drinks. While the prices were slightly on the higher side, the quality and taste were decent. Staff members were polite and helpful whenever assistance was needed.
Overall, INOX Raghuleela Mall Kandivali is a good option for movie lovers looking for comfort, good audio-visual quality, and a reliable cinema experience. It’s a suitable place for family outings, friends, or solo movie plans.

I am writing to express my disappointment with the lack of proper provision of water cups during my recent visit to your theatre.

The manager gave only one metal glass between 100 people. It was unsanitary and a potential health hazard. The show was already housefull, being aware about the situation and climate condition your managing team should be aware of it and should keep sufficient disposable water glasses. As you are aware, we are facing a global pandemic, and it is imperative that businesses take the necessary precautions to ensure the safety of their customers. Providing only one metal glass for multiple people to use is unacceptable, especially in a packed theatre where the risk of transmission is already heightened.

In addition to the lack of water cups, I was also dismayed to discover that you are charging an exorbitant price of Rs. 65 for a bottle of water. This is an unfair and unreasonable price to charge for a necessity like water, particularly when customers are already paying for movie tickets and other snacks.

Hence, this Portray sells water bottles to customers and charges exorbitant prices. I strongly urge you to reconsider your approach to providing water in your theatre. It is your responsibility as a business to ensure that your customers have access to clean drinking water, and this includes providing sufficient cups for everyone.

I hope you will take my concerns seriously and take immediate action and a resolution. Thank you for your attention to this matter.

featured_reviews.name: Jaimeen Bulsara
featured_reviews.review_text: Had a wonderful experience at Ajanta Cinex. This was our second time coming here. The movie watching experience itself is amazing, it is currently the only single screen theatre with Dolby sound system. Clean, comfortable seating, delicious food options (we tried the momos, pizza, and coffee, along with the usual samosa and popcorn). The freshly made momos and pizza were better than some of the food places we’ve eaten at. Overall a total 5 on 5 experience. Would definitely come again soon.
